name: Magi
overview: The Magi, known as wise men from the east, are biblically connected to the fulfillment of God's promises concerning the coming Messiah. Prophetic passages such as Numbers 24:17 anticipate a star arising from Jacob, signaling the arrival of a ruler, while Psalm 72 portrays kings bringing gifts in homage. Isaiah 60 further depicts Gentile nations and kings coming to the light of Israel, bearing gold and incense, which aligns with the Magi's visit to the infant Jesus, honoring Him as King and Savior. This event underscores the recognition of Christ's divine kingship beyond Israel and the fulfillment of Old Testament prophecy.
